sections.content:

### ⚠️ DISCLAIMER — READ ME FIRST

**Version 0.1 — Personal working draft / Unofficial**
*May 2026*

This document is a **personal and private tool**, created entirely from my own daily experience as a worker at DHL Tiel, BONT section. Its sole purpose is to optimize my internal processes and serve as a personal support guide to keep the steps to follow present during my workday.

**⚠️ IMPORTANT — THIS IS NOT AN OFFICIAL DOCUMENT**

- ❌ **Not** an official DHL document.
- ❌ **Not** reviewed, approved, nor endorsed by the company, its supervisors, teamleaders, or any department of DHL Supply Chain or DHL Global.
- ❌ **Not** intended to replace, modify, or supersede the protocols officially established by the company, the training manuals, the standard operating procedures (SOPs), or the safety instructions in force at DHL Tiel.

**✅ What it IS:**

- ✅ A personal compendium of practices learned day by day.
- ✅ A quick-reference guide for **individual use** under my own full responsibility.
- ✅ A personal improvement proposal that I share with those who wish to use it, **always under their own judgment and responsibility**.

**🛡️ TERMS OF USE**

- Any person who uses this document does so **at their own risk**. I, Boris Orlando Antequera Vargas, am not responsible for errors, omissions, decisions made based on this document, nor for consequences arising from its use.
- The codes, error messages, procedures, nomenclatures, screenshots, images, videos, and any other content referenced herein **have not been validated or authorized by DHL**. Their inclusion in this draft is tentative and subject to verification and official approval before considering any extended use.
- **This document must not be presented as official DHL material** under any circumstances.
- If DHL so requires, this document will be withdrawn or modified immediately.

**📸 ABOUT PHOTOS, VIDEOS AND SCREENSHOTS:**

All visual references in this document (photos, videos, screenshots) are marked as ``. No real images of people, equipment, facilities, or the Blue Yonder system will be included until express written authorization is obtained from the competent authorities at DHL Tiel, in compliance with the company's privacy, security, and confidentiality policies. Current visual references are **conceptual placeholders**.

sections.title: 🌟 THE GOLDEN RULE (Your daily mantra)
sections.content:
> Something wrong? Don't panic.

1. **SET ASIDE** the problematic product (to the side, without blocking the flow).
2. **KEEP** working with the next one (flow is sacred).
3. **CHECK** what you set aside when the pace slows down (during low-load moments).

---

sections.title: 🏹 STARTUP CHECKLIST (Before the shift)
sections.content:
- [ ] **Scanner:** Enough battery? Clean screen?
- [ ] **Printer:** Does your printer number match the scanner (e.g. BNT09)? Paper loaded?
- [ ] **Supplies:** Spare rolls? Pen to write down LPN?

---

sections.title: 📚 QUICK GLOSSARY (for newcomers)
sections.content:
> ⚠️ *Note: The following terms, codes and nomenclatures are those used in daily BONT operations. Their definition here is tentative andto confirm they correspond exactly to corporate terminology.*

| Term | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| **RCG** | Rolling container (cage) where loose packages are placed.|
| **Pallet** | Wooden platform for krats or heavy items.|
| **LPN** | Barcode that identifies each RCG/pallet (its "ID").|
| **SSCC** | Barcode of each product (box, item).|
| **Blue Yonder** | The WMS system (the main screen you see).|
| **Smart Scanner** | Application for entering unregistered products or reprinting labels.|
| **Krat** | Uniform plastic box (stackable).|
| **Troubleshooter** | Technical support (Martin at control post).|
| **Teamleader** | Direct supervisor.|

---

sections.title: 🔴 RED CATEGORY – Physical loading problems
sections.content:
> *"Quality before speed (but with champion pace)"*
Loading an RCG or pallet is like playing Tetris in real life. Each piece must go in its place so the customer receives their product perfectly.

### 🏆 What IS done (Hall of Fame)
[📷 FOTO]

- **The Tetris Master:** RCG with boxes snugly fitted, no dangerous gaps.
- **Elite Pallet of Krats:** Krats aligned, labels facing outward.
- **Smart mixed assembly:** Heavy base at the bottom, pipes protected on the sides, light boxes on top.

### ❌ What is NOT done (Avoid disaster)

| Error | Description | Solution | Status |
|-------|-------------|----------|--------|
| 🚫 Product protrudes from RCG | Outside the metal perimeter. | Relocate inside. If it doesn't fit, use another RCG. | [PENDING] |
| 📏 Height > 2.3 m | Risk of tipping or damage. | Measure visually. Redistribute. | [PENDING] |
| ⬆️ Arrows ignored | Box with arrow pointing down or sideways. | Rotate until arrow points up. No arrow = fragile. | [PENDING] |
| 🎩 Hat effect | Large box on top of small one. | Base ≥ top box; heavy at bottom. | [PENDING] |
| 🔧 Pipes on top of boxes | Pipes resting on cardboard. | Always at the back or side of the RCG. | [PENDING] |
| 📋 Krats with labels facing inward | Codes hidden. | Stickers visible facing outward. | [PENDING] |

---

sections.title: 🟡 YELLOW CATEGORY – Scanner and system errors
sections.content:
### 📋 Common messages and actions table

| Screen message | What it means | Action | Status |
|----------------|---------------|--------|--------|
| "No inventory found" | The product has no location in the system. | Use INVENTORY DSP (see below). | *** |
| "SSCC number is wrong or missing" | The scanned code is invalid or missing. | → Go to GREEN CATEGORY (part 1) – INBOUND/SURPLUS method. | *** |
| "Pallet position contains a different pallet number" | You scanned the wrong RCG/pallet. | Relocate the product in the correct container. (Container mix-up – also ORANGE CAT.). | *** |
| "Inventory identifier is invalid" | **🚨 | Take product to Teamleaders or Troubleshooter. | *** |
| Scanner not responding (frozen screen) | Distance, dirty label, or low battery. | Adjust distance, clean, if it persists set product aside and test manually. | *** |

### 🔍 INVENTORY DSP Protocol (for resolving set-aside products)

1. In Blue Yonder → three dots (...) → **TOOLS** → **INVENTORY DSP**.
2. Scan the product.
3. **PRO TIP:** Press down arrow 8 times to see all the info.
4. Interpret the codes:

| INVENTORY DSP Code | Meaning | Action | Status |
|--------------------|---------|--------|--------|
| **rolpalbc** | OPEN container. Look for the number and deposit WITHOUT SCANNING. | Find the container and place the product without using the scanner. | *** |
| **PND-A** | Product READY for today. Open a new RCG/pallet or look for its own. | Open a new container or find the one already assigned. | *** |
| **PND-P** | CLOSED RCG or pallet. Look for the number and deposit WITHOUT SCANNING. | Find the closed container and place. | *** |
| **T3-STGE** | Already in truck line. Take it to the loading area (GC). | Take the product to the loading area (GC). | *** |

### ⚡ Scanner not responding – step-by-step solution

1. Adjust distance and clean the label.
2. If it doesn't work, **SET ASIDE** the product.
3. When load decreases, enter the **SSCC manually** (it is printed).
4. If it still doesn't work or the code is damaged, inform **Teamleaders**.

---

sections.title: 🟢 GREEN CATEGORY – Smart Scanner, labels and printer
sections.content:
### 📦 PART 1: Product entry (INBOUND / SURPLUS)

Use **Smart Scanner** when the normal scanner says "NOT FOUND" or "SSCC number is wrong or missing".

#### INBOUND Method

1. Scan the lower code (SSCC).
2. Choose the type (KRT, COL…).
3. If it says **"NOT FOUND"**, switch to SURPLUS.

#### SURPLUS Method

1. Switch to **SURPLUS** mode.
2. Scan the lower code + upper code (client).
3. If it says **"ANOTHER POSITION"**, go back to INBOUND.

### 🖨️ PART 2: LPN label management, printer and closing

#### PROTOCOL A – Retrieve LPN to continue loading

⚠️ **Only works if you have a scanned product** (screen asks for destination LPN).

1. Blue Yonder → three dots → **CHANGE POSITION**.
2. Down arrow → LPN appears.
3. **Write it down on paper** (cannot be copied to Smart Scanner).
4. Smart Scanner → **PRINTING** → select your printer → **LPN PRINTING** → enter code manually.

#### PROTOCOL B – Close RCG/pallet without physical LPN

1. Obtain LPN with CHANGE POSITION (protocol A).
2. Go to **DONE** and paste the LPN code.

#### PROTOCOL C – RCG/pallet already closed without closing stickers

1. Smart Scanner → **PRINTING** → choose **SSCC INTERGAMMA**.
2. Print **2 copies**.
3. Attach:
   - **Front** + **next to the original LPN**.
   - On pallet of krats, place the sticker **between the krats** so it doesn't fall off.

### 🛠️ Printer problems

| Problem | Solution | Status |
|---------|----------|--------|
| No stickers come out when doing DONE | Restart the printer. | *** |
| Stains or white parts | Clean the print head. | *** |
| Red light | Out of paper or battery. | *** |

---

sections.title: 🟠 ORANGE CATEGORY – Emergencies and human errors
sections.content:
### 🎨 Paint or liquid spill (Critical mission)

1. **The flow does NOT stop** – keep working while managing it.
2. Go to the **emergency kit (sand)** and spread it over the spill.
3. Clean **from the outside inward**.
4. Dispose of waste in **special containers**.
5. Inform **Teamleader or Troubleshooter** immediately.

### ❌ Container mix-up (frequent human error)

- **Symptom:** You scan the LPN of an RCG/pallet that does not match the destination.
- **Action:** Verify destination on screen, compare numbers, relocate product.
- If it's a repeated pattern, inform Teamleaders.

### ❌ Scanning a product without placing it (bad habit)

- **Consequence:** The system registers the product as "placed" (but it isn't). Later another operator scans the same product and gets an error.
- **Prevention:** Never scan without placing. If the RCG is full, close it, replace with an empty one, then scan.
- **If it happened:** Try to place it; if there's no space, inform Teamleaders.

### 👀 You find a product in the wrong place

1. Scan to see the destination.
2. If possible, place it where indicated.
3. If not, use **INVENTORY DSP** (it may be in a neighboring container).
4. If it's on the floor, consult inventory dsp.
5. If you see a repeated pattern, inform Teamleaders.

---

sections.title: 🔵 BLUE CATEGORY – Best practices (Legend Level)
sections.content:
- **Eyes on the screen:** Verify every scan. One second avoids minutes of errors.
- **Teamwork:** If you help on another line, talk to your colleague before opening a new location.
- **Combat cleanliness:** Clear floor (pick up plastics, trash). A clean station is a safe one.
- **Help newcomers:** Share knowledge with respect. We've all been beginners.

---

sections.title: 🟣 PURPLE CATEGORY – Pocket Codes
sections.content:
> *"When the system logs you out, don't waste time going to the codes area. Carry them with you at all times."*
### 📋 Codes every operator should have on hand

| Type | What for? |
|------|-----------|
| **Personal QR** | Login in Blue Yonder and Smart Scanner |
| **📍 Location** | Work area (e.g. BNT09) |
| **⚙️ Equipment** | Identifies your equipment (hand in BONT) |
| **🔢 Shift Code** | The day's work code |

These codes must be included in the **pocket cards** and in the **"Guerrero BONT" app** so that, when the system logs you out by mistake, you can scan them from your workstation without having to walk to the codes area.

---

sections.title: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
sections.content:
| Question | Answer | Status |
|----------|--------|--------|
| What do I do if the scanner won't connect? | Check the battery. If it fails, ask the teamleader for a replacement. | *** |
| How do I change the battery? | They are in the charger at the break area. Turn off the scanner, replace. | *** |
| Where are the label rolls? | In the supply warehouse (next to the control post). | *** |
| Who do I call if nothing works? | First Teamleader, then Troubleshooter (Martin). | *** |
| Can I move a closed container without stickers? | No. Use protocol C from the Green category to reprint the stickers. | *** |

---

sections.title: 📞 CONTACTS AND ZONES
sections.content:
- **Teamleaders:** Your captains (at the central post).
- **Troubleshooter (Martin):** BONT control post.
- **Unresolved Zone:** Place for products without labels or with illegible codes.

- **Another Day Zone:** Packages whose date is not today's.

---

sections.title: 📚 COMPLETE SCENARIO (Practical example)
sections.content:
A product arrives, the scanner beeps and says **"No inventory found"**. You set the product aside. When the load decreases, you use **INVENTORY DSP** and see that the code is **PND-A**. That means it's for today, so you open a new RCG and place it. All good.

sections.title: 🌍 MULTILINGUAL VERSION – For an international team
sections.content:
At DHL Tiel we work with people from many nationalities: Polish, Romanian, Bulgarian, Ukrainian, Portuguese, Arab, Persian, English, Dutch, and more. Each one deserves to understand the processes in their own language to work safely, quickly, and without errors.

That is why this master document (the original `.md` file in Spanish) has been translated into the following languages:

| Language | File | Status |
|----------|------|--------|
| 🇪🇸 Spanish | `manual-v0.1.md` | Original |
| 🇬🇧 English | `manual-v0.1-en.md` | Translated |

| 🇺🇦 Ukrainian | `manual-v0.1-uk.md` | Translated |

> ⚠️ *Note: All translations maintain the full content of the original. Technical terms (LPN, SSCC, RCG, Blue Yonder, Smart Scanner, INVENTORY DSP, etc.) are kept in their original nomenclature as they are system terms.*

For printing in front of supervisors or managers, it is recommended to use the **English** or **Dutch** versions, which are the management languages at DHL Tiel.

---

sections.title: 📱 VISION: "Guerrero BONT" Mobile App
sections.content:
This manual is the conceptual foundation for a **mobile application** that will allow:

- **Consult any procedure in seconds** from your phone (no searching through papers)
- **Visual navigation by category** with the interactive flow diagram
- **Integrated photos and videos** (when approved) to see real examples
- **Built-in multi-language** — the user chooses their language and sees the translated content
- **Quick search** for errors, codes (SSCC, LPN, PND-A, etc.)
- **Digital start-of-shift checklist**
- **Offline mode** — no internet needed, always available in the warehouse

An app allows much more extensiveness and detail than a printed document: demonstration videos, animations, direct links to each protocol, and real-time updates can be included.

> ⚠️ ---

sections.title: 🃏 POCKET CARDS (Practical)
sections.content:
In addition to the full manual and the future app, there is the idea of creating **laminated pocket cards** with the most critical information to carry on the uniform:

- **Side A:** The Golden Rule + Summarized flow diagram
- **Side B:** Scanner error table with quick actions
- **Side C:** INVENTORY DSP codes (rolpalbc, PND-A, PND-P, T3-STGE)
- **Side D:** Key contacts (Teamleaders, Troubleshooter) + zones

These cards are complementary to the manual and the app; they do not replace them.

> ⚠️ ---

sections.title: 📜 FINAL DECLARATION
sections.content:
This document has been created with the best intention: **to help**. Help myself remember the steps, help someone starting out not to feel lost, help the team have a quick reference. It is not intended to be a corporate manual or to compete with DHL's official training.

If this document helps someone do their job better, mission accomplished. If DHL considers it should be withdrawn, modified or adapted, it will be done without issue.

---

sections.title: 💡 My commitment to DHL
sections.content:
This manual stems from a personal conviction: **knowledge is worthless if it stays in one person's head**. Sharing it is the only way for the entire team to improve.

My daily goal is simple:

- ✅ **Learn from every mistake** so as not to repeat it.
- ✅ **Help the person next to me** without anyone asking.
- ✅ **Leave the workstation better than I found it.**

I believe in a job well done, in quality as a pillar, in safety as a priority, and in efficiency as a consequence of doing things right. I want the team to function, quality to rise, and newcomers not to suffer what I suffered when starting out. And if that helps DHL Tiel become a benchmark — so be it.

This manual is my grain of sand. If someone reads it and learns something, it was already worth it.

> **"Shared knowledge is multiplied efficiency."**
> *— Boris Orlando Antequera Vargas — BONT Operator*

---
